### Caleb's Can-Do Attitude, Part Two
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living
URL: https://insight.org/resources/daily-devotional/individual/caleb's-can-do-attitude-part-two
Passage: Joshua 14:12
Points:
- Caleb actively embraced a formidable new challenge even at eighty-five years old.
- He kept himself disciplined and resisted the temptation to settle into passive retirement.
- His boldness came from a lifetime of following the Lord wholeheartedly.
- Believers of all ages should remain energetic in faith and ready for God's call.

### Looking Forward
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/harvest-daily-with-greg-laurie-oct-13-2006-1435829.html
Passage: Joshua 14:12
Points:
- There is no retirement from spiritual growth or the Christian life.
- Caleb deliberately requested rugged terrain inhabited by formidable giants instead of an easy allotment.
- Hebron represented a place of sacred promise and fellowship with God.
- Spiritual longevity depends on continually looking forward rather than dwelling on the past.
